findings.title: YouCam API Skin AI & eCommerce VTO Hackathon — second round
findings.entry_cost: No purchase/payment required; free YouCam API account and up to 1000 redeemable API units offered; ongoing hosting/extra usage costs not verified.

prize_breakdown.eligibility: team with at least one self-identified woman member at submission
team with at least one currently enrolled student with school-issued email

findings.eligibility: Adults at age of majority, qualifying teams/organizations; official excluded territories include Brazil, Italy, Quebec and sanctioned jurisdictions; sponsor/judge affiliates excluded. No general students-only requirement in full official rules, though a special prize is student-restricted.
findings.scope: Working web/mobile app using at least one Perfect Corp YouCam API, with clear consumer/eCommerce value; newly created or significantly updated since Sep 29, 2026. Repository (public or shared with organizer), project description, 1-3 minute public demo video and functioning evaluation access required. Sponsor/API terms and third-party licenses apply.
findings.payout: Awards contingent on verification/affidavits; organizer states delivery within 60 days of required forms; tax/fees borne by winners.
findings.confidence: high for organizer-published dates/prize/eligibility; participant account/API availability not tested
findings.relevance: moderate: AI-agent API integration and rapid web prototyping; lower direct relevance to cryptography solver than Qloo/GitLab
findings.deduplication: Separate second-round competition from July 6-Aug 17 YouCam Skin AI & Apparel VTO Hackathon at youcam-api.devpost.com. No existing event-specific entry found in current main intelligence/opportunity catalogs or open PR title search.

actual API account creation and free-unit redemption
cost to host working prototype and maintain judging access
